title: T1-T2 EZ inside T1-T12 rib cage specimen, follower load 400 N (Sis 2016)
subcategory: segment within long specimen with rib cage

quantity.name: EZ
quantity.definition: elastic zone: angular displacement from end of NZ to maximal load (Wilke 1998)

source.authors: Sis HL, Mannen EM, Wong BM, Cadel ES, Bouxsein ML, Anderson DE, Friis EA
source.sample: 8 fresh-frozen human T1-T12 thoracic spines with intact rib cage (same specimens as Anderson 2016)

protocol.summary: T1-T12 with intact rib cage, T1/T12 potted; FS20 spine tester, pure moment +/-5 Nm at T1, 1 deg/s, 5 cycles (3rd analysed); follower load 0, 200, 400 N via cables through eyelets at estimated centres of rotation (T1-T11). Optotrak pins in left pedicles of T1, T2, T4, T5, T8, T9, T11.
how_to_simulate: Fix T12, apply pure moments +/-5 Nm to T1 in LB, FE, AR with 400 N follower load along the curvature
Model the full rib cage (sternum, costal cartilage, ribs, costovertebral joints)
Report rotation of the upper vs lower tracked vertebra of T1-T2 (Euler decomposition)
protocol.notes: Mean (SD), n=8 (cells with <5 contributing specimens reported as missing). Note T11 pin used for T11-T12 FSU (T12 potted) and T8-T12 region. NZ/EZ stiffness (Tables 3-4) not extracted.

extraction.check_notes: Parsed from text layer (split digits such as '0.9 2' re-joined); SDs mapped to non-missing cells; spot-checked T1/T2 0 N and Lower 400 N rows.

ribcage.intact_structures: full rib cage with sternum, costal cartilage, ribs, costovertebral joints and ligaments; muscles (incl. intercostals presumably) removed

loading.device: FS20 spine tester (Applied Test Systems), Optotrak
